lastCompletedStory.title: Self-authored artifact shape-pin fixtures + replay against guards

nextStoryContext: US-003 added test/supervisor/golden-artifacts.test.ts (new file, not an extension of an existing describe block, since no single existing test file naturally covers all four self-authored artifacts). Committed fixtures: test/fixtures/golden/worker-report.json + review-report.json replay directly against parseWorkerReport/parseReviewReport (src/supervisor/report-parse.ts) fed the raw fixture string; orch-handoff.json is written via writeFileSync into a real mkdtempSync tmpdir under ORCH_HANDOFF_FILENAME then read back with readOrchHandoff (it reads from disk by contract, so it cannot be fed as a string); handoff.json (the worker-handoff contract, no dedicated runtime parser) is validated against scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json via a small hand-rolled recursive JSON-Schema-subset validator local to the test file (imports the schema as a JSON module, resolveJsonModule already true, precedented by src/supervisor/events.ts:32) rather than hardcoding today's required-field list, so a future schema change is what actually drives pass/fail. This closes CAM-302's shape-pin fixture set (US-001 sentinel/tag fixtures, US-002 transcript-usage fixture, US-003 the four self-authored-artifact fixtures); check whether any further stories remain in this PRD before assuming more shape-pin work is needed.
